summary: P-07B drive-end vibration rose to 7.9 mm/s RMS on 2026-10-20 and the pump was placed in standby with LOTO tag #4471 applied. Inspection on 2026-10-21 found coupling misalignment 0.32 mm and discoloured grease; laser alignment was completed on 2026-10-22 and bearings were regreased, with a 30 min test run on 2026-10-23 showing 2.4 mm/s vibration. The work order restores P-07B to service with adjusted VFD ramp and confirmed protection setpoints.

steps.instruction: Confirm LOTO tag #4471 removed by authorised technician.
Set VFD D-07B ramp-up time to 12 s.
Set vibration alarm setpoint to 7.1 mm/s.
Set vibration trip setpoint to 11.0 mm/s.
Set discharge pressure high limit to 6.2 bar.
Return P-07B to duty/standby rotation, lead pump P-07A.
Log first 24 h vibration trend and upload at next maintenance window.
